climate.forecast_method: Simple statistical projection, not a weather forecast: for each variable, a least-squares fit of one mean per calendar month plus a single linear trend over the NASA POWER monthly record, extended 12 months ahead. Rain is not projected (the climatology is used). Back-test (fit 1991–2020, test 2021–2025): temperature: MAE 0.86 °C vs 1.13 for the climatology baseline, so the trend model beats it; ET0: MAE 6.42 mm/month vs 7.05 for the climatology baseline, so the trend model beats it.

warnings: Mean annual rain 2016–2025 (120 mm) is more than double the 1991–2005 mean (52 mm). This may reflect a change in the NASA POWER precipitation source rather than real rainfall, and must not be read as a climate trend.
assumptions: Kc follows the FAO-56 four-stage curve (initial, development, mid-season, late season) with stage lengths as fractions of the growing window (default 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.40 / 0.20, provisional until replaced with FAO-56 Table 11 lengths); monthly Kc is the curve's mean over the month.
ETc = ET0 x Kc per month, with ET0 from FAO-56 Penman-Monteith on the NASA POWER monthly climatology.
Effective rain = 0.8 x monthly rain (a fixed fraction, not a soil water balance).
Irrigation need = max(ETc - effective rain, 0) per month; no soil water storage, leaching or conveyance losses.
A month shared by two crops (harvest of one, sowing of the next) counts at half weight for each.
Water score = clip(50 + % irrigation saved versus your current rotation, 0, 100): your current rotation scores 50 and a 25% saving scores 75.
Heat-stress exposure (proxy): Compares monthly mean temperature with each crop's ECOCROP optimal maximum (harvest month excluded). It does not model heat at flowering or daily maximum temperatures.
Soil-health practices (proxy) = legume in rotation (40) + plant-family diversity (30) + months with ground cover (30); it counts practices and is not a measured soil outcome.
Kc values and regional calendars are provisional until verified against FAO-56 Table 12 and local sources.
Indicative gross revenue = national average yield x February 2024 procurement prices; it is shown for information only and is not part of the scores.
